entities.name: Mustafa Adrisi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Mustafa Adrisi Abataki was a Ugandan military officer and politician who served as the third vice president of Uganda from 1977 to 1979 and was one of President Idi Amin's closest associates before the two fell out.
